Maya (Finance): FYI spotted a mismatch after yesterday's embedding recount backfill. Some invoices show fewer billed embeddings than our raw event counts.
Alex (Eng-Infra): Which backfill? job id?
Maya (Finance): job_2024_09_embed_recount_B. Sampled invoices: INV-4021, INV-4033. Ledger rows around 2024-09-10T04:00Z.
Billing Bot: job_2024_09_embed_recount_B finished. processed=2,140,600 wrote=2,100,800 errors=0.
Kevin (Eng-ML): wrote < processed indicates some events were dropped. Could be dedupe or rate-limit handling.
Alex (Eng-Infra): I grabbed the recount logs. There's a filter that excludes events with rate_limit=true unless final_status==succeeded within the recount window. If retries finished after the window they got omitted.
Maya (Finance): Rough sample suggests 1-4% undercount on heavy embed users. Need to know affected customers and magnitude.
Maria (Billing Ops): If confirmed, we need to issue credits or rerun recount. Approval needed for credits > $5k.
Sam (Head of Finance): Approve provisional credits up to $5k. If larger, escalate to me.
Alex (Eng-Infra): I'll run a focused dry recount that merges final_status history before filtering. ETA ~3 hours. Will output per-invoice deltas.
Kevin (Eng-ML): I'll push a quick fix to recount logic to consult event_history rather than only recent status. PR#5489.
Billing Bot: dryrun_job_2024_09_recount_B started by alex.
Alex (Eng-Infra): Dry run done, sample deltas: INV-4021 delta=+9,712 embeddings (~$38.85), INV-4033 delta=+45,210 (~$180.84), INV-4040 delta=+1,234 (~$4.93).
Maya (Finance): Those are under the provisional threshold. Maria, proceed with credit memos and customer notifications for these three.
Maria (Billing Ops): On it. I'll attach CSV and templated note.
Kevin (Eng-ML): After shipping the fix, recommend adding an alert: recount_written < recount_processed. Also add a test simulating delayed retries.
Alex (Eng-Infra): Agreed. I'll add the alert and a rolling job that validates counts weekly.
Sam (Head of Finance): Thanks all. Please drop final CSV + short write-up in #postmortems when done.
Maya (Finance): Will close loop once credits posted and alert live. :white_check_mark:
